```{webr}
#| label: load opt data
#| envir: table_2
opt_data <- readRDS("data/opt_data.rds") |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    .data[["Birth.outcome"]] %in% c("Non-live birth", "Live birth")
  )
```

```{webr}
#| caption: pregnant duration and birth weight summary table
#| label: pregnant duration and birth weight summary table
#| envir: table_2
birth_weight <- opt_data |> 
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    include = c(
      "Preg_duration_32", "Preg_duration_35", "Preg_duration_37",
      "Birthweight", "Birthweight_2500", "Birthweight_1500"
    ),
    by = "Group",
    missing = "no",
    label = list(
      "Preg_duration_32" ~ "<32 wk",
      "Preg_duration_35" ~ "<35 wk",
      "Preg_duration_37" ~ "<37 wk",
      "Birthweight" ~ "Total weight - g",
      "Birthweight_2500" ~ "<2500 g - no./total no. (%)",
      "Birthweight_1500" ~ "<1500 g - no./total no. (%)"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "{mean}±{sd}",
      c("Preg_duration_32", "Preg_duration_35", "Preg_duration_37") ~ "{n} ({p})",
      c("Birthweight_2500", "Birthweight_1500") ~ "{n}/{N} ({p})"
    ),
    digits = list(
      c("Birthweight") ~ gtsummary::label_style_number(digits = 0, big.mark = ""),
      c("Birthweight_2500", "Birthweight_1500") ~ c(0, 0, 1)
    )
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::add_p(
    test = list(
      c("Preg_duration_32", "Preg_duration_35", "Preg_duration_37") ~ "fisher.test"
    ),
    pvalue_fun = gtsummary::label_style_pvalue(digits = 2)
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::add_variable_group_header(
    header = "Duration of pregnancy - no. (%)",
    variables = starts_with("Preg_")
  ) |>
  gtsummary::add_variable_group_header(
    header = "Birth weight",
    variables = c("Birthweight", "Birthweight_2500", "Birthweight_1500")
  ) |>
  gtsummary::remove_footnote_header()

birth_weight
```

```{webr}
#| caption: live birth summary table
#| label: live birth summary table
#| envir: table_2
p_value_style <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == 1 ~ "1.0",
    x > 0.99 & x < 1 ~ "0.99",
    .default = gtsummary::style_pvalue(x, digits = 2)
  )
}

live_birth <- opt_data |> 
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    include = c(
      "Have_Live_Birth", "Preterm_32", "Preterm_35", "Preterm_37"
    ),
    by = "Group",
    missing = "no",
    label = list(
      "Have_Live_Birth" ~ "Total",
      "Preterm_32" ~ "<32 wk",
      "Preterm_35" ~ "<35 wk",
      "Preterm_37" ~ "<37 wk"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      c("Have_Live_Birth", "Preterm_32", "Preterm_35", "Preterm_37") ~ "{n} ({p})"
    ),
    digits = list(
      c("Have_Live_Birth", "Preterm_32", "Preterm_35", "Preterm_37") ~ c(0, 1)
    )
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::add_p(
    test = list(
      c("Preterm_32", "Preterm_35", "Preterm_37") ~ "fisher.test"
    ),
    pvalue_fun = p_value_style
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::add_variable_group_header(
    header = "Preterm",
    variables = c("Preterm_32", "Preterm_35", "Preterm_37")
  ) |>
  # understand table body
  gtsummary::modify_table_body(
    ~ .x |> 
      tibble::add_row(
        row_type = "variable_group", 
        label = "Live births - no. (%)", 
        .before = 1
      )
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::modify_table_body(
    ~ .x |> 
      dplyr::mutate(
        `p.value` = dplyr::case_when(
          .data[["variable"]] == "Have_Live_Birth" ~ NA,
          .default = .data[["p.value"]]
        )
      )
  ) |>
  gtsummary::modify_indent(
    columns = "label", 
    rows = .data[["label"]] %in% c("Total", "Preterm"), 
    indent = 4L
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::modify_indent(
    columns = "label", 
    rows = .data[["variable"]] %in% c("Preterm_32", "Preterm_35", "Preterm_37"), 
    indent = 8L
  ) |>
  gtsummary::remove_footnote_header()

live_birth
```

```{webr}
#| caption: stack table2
#| label: stack table2
#| envir: table_2
long_footnote <- paste(
   "The numbers of patients in the study groups do not include",
   "those who withdrew from the study or were lost to follow up.",
   "Two women who underwent elevtive abortions were treated as",
   "lost to follow-up at the time of abortion.",
   "Plus-minus values are means±SD, unless otherwise noted."
)

table2 <- gtsummary::tbl_stack(
   tbls = list(birth_weight, live_birth)
  ) |>
  gtsummary::modify_header(
    label = "**Outcome**",
    stat_1 = "**Control Group**  \n**(N = {n})**",
    stat_2 = "**Treatment Group**  \n**(N = {n})**",
    p.value = "**P value**",
    text_interpret = "md"
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::remove_footnote_header() |> 
  gtsummary::modify_footnote_body(
    footnote = "P Values in this category were calculated with the use of Fisher's exact test.",
    columns = "label",
    rows = .data[["label"]] == "Duration of pregnancy - no. (%)" & .data[["row_type"]] == "variable_group"
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::modify_footnote_body(
    footnote = "This category includes all live preterm births in the specified gestational period. Percentages were calculated as a frction of all live births.",
    columns = "label",
    rows = .data[["label"]] == "Preterm" & .data[["row_type"]] == "variable_group"
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::as_gt() |> 
  gt::tab_header(
    title = "Table 2. Birth and Clinical Periodontal Outcomes."
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_options(heading.align = "left") |> 
  gt::tab_footnote(
    footnote = long_footnote,
    locations = gt::cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) |> 
  gt::opt_footnote_marks(marks = c("*", "†", "§")) |> 
  gt::opt_footnote_spec(
    spec_ref = "i",   # Removes '^' (superscript), keeps italics 'i'
    spec_ftr = "x"    # Unstyled or baseline text for the footer
  )

table2
```
